content_details.name: Butterfly Æffect: Papillons à Quatre Mains
content_details.short_description: A visual novel about love and violence set in the early 2000's.
content_details.about_the_game:
'Quatre mains' is a duet where both players share a single piano.

By inserting yourself into a performance that's already begun, you'll just ruin the music and annoy the pianists.

Butterfly Æffect is a multi-route visual novel inspired by bishoujo games and early 2000s American anime culture. It’s about 50k words, or about 5 hours long if you read it out loud without stopping.

You play as Damien, a freshman at a remote college who dreams of making a thrilling foray into adulthood and romance.

Stuck between two pairs of best friends, how will you pursue one without breaking the other's heart?

Gabrielle is anime club royalty. She's best friends and ex-roommates with Raine, a quiet artist with eccentric tastes.

Vi is a cool and beautiful graduate student and your Biology TA. Ollie is her childhood friend...or something more?

content_details.name: Lost Emblem of Time
content_details.short_description: A retro 8-bit JRPG just like the classic final fantasy games. You know with turn-based combat and a story-driven adventure. Explore a vast world filled with dangerous enemies, mini-games, ect.
content_details.about_the_game:
Do you ever feel that newer final fantasy games doesn't feel the same like in the past? Do you ever want to go back in a new experience? Well, this game is for you! 

A retro 8-bit-style JRPG featuring turn-based combat and a deeply story-driven adventure. Journey through a retro and expanding world filled with dangerous enemies, engaging mini-games, hidden treasures, and a wide variety of locations to explore. As you progress, uncover secrets, grow stronger, and experience an emotional narrative that continues to expand with every step of your journey.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Long ago, in a world of fantasy, a powerful force of darkness began to rise. A ruthless ruler seized the Crystal of Darkness, gaining unimaginable power and forming his own army, the Imperials. With this strength, he seeks to plunge the world into ruin by unleashing the Fog of Darkness, a force capable of consuming everything in its path.

The ancient Heroes of Light once stood against him, however, they never make it. 

Now, with the world on the brink of collapse, the light calls out once more: choosing four new heroes to take their place.

Emily, Lancer, Leon, and Rem are drawn together by fate, though each of them is burdened by their own struggles and past. Reluctant or not, they must rise to face a destiny far greater than themselves.

To stand against the Dark Lord and his Imperials, they must seek out the four sacred crystals: Earth, Flame, Water, and Light. Before darkness claims them first.

The fate of the world now rests in their hands.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The art is from RPG Maker MV DLC pack, but I edited some of the art, using the same style (No ai of course). The music as well...

content_details.detailed_description:
Do you ever feel that newer final fantasy games doesn't feel the same like in the past? Do you ever want to go back in a new experience? Well, this game is for you! 

A retro 8-bit-style JRPG featuring turn-based combat and a deeply story-driven adventure. Journey through a retro and expanding world filled with dangerous enemies, engaging mini-games, hidden treasures, and a wide variety of locations to explore. As you progress, uncover secrets, grow stronger, and experience an emotional narrative that continues to expand with every step of your journey.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Long ago, in a world of fantasy, a powerful force of darkness began to rise. A ruthless ruler seized the Crystal of Darkness, gaining unimaginable power and forming his own army, the Imperials. With this strength, he seeks to plunge the world into ruin by unleashing the Fog of Darkness, a force capable of consuming everything in its path.

The ancient Heroes of Light once stood against him, however, they never make it. 

Now, with the world on the brink of collapse, the light calls out once more: choosing four new heroes to take their place.

Emily, Lancer, Leon, and Rem are drawn together by fate, though each of them is burdened by their own struggles and past. Reluctant or not, they must rise to face a destiny far greater than themselves.

To stand against the Dark Lord and his Imperials, they must seek out the four sacred crystals: Earth, Flame, Water, and Light. Before darkness claims them first.

The fate of the world now rests in their hands.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Short disclaimer: This game is work of fiction. 

The art is from RPG Maker MV DLC pack, but I edited some of the art, using the same style (No ai of course). The music as well...

content_details.about_the_game:
A Roguelike vertical shooter

Stellar Resonance is a Roguelike vertical shoot 'em up with survivor-style builds. Every run starts light: fly the scrolling routes, thread through bullet patterns, and sweep up flowers, crystals and little cakes to level up as you go.

Pick one of three. Build your own firepower.

Each level-up offers three cards. Rapid fire, homing shots, orbiting flower blades, chain lightning, lasers and support drones: add a new weapon or push a favorite further. No two runs build the same way.

Break the armor, piece by piece

Every boss pilots a mech with detachable parts. Shoot off the first part and her outfit tears for the first time. Strip away every part until only the pilot remains, and the clothing damage advances to its second stage. Each break triggers a close-up cut-in, so every hit you land shows.

Ten worlds, ten bosses

Cross flower gardens, icy skies, floating cities and stellar rings, and face a different boss with her own bullet patterns at the end of each world.

Six pilots, six ways to fly

Unlock balanced fighters, fast interceptors, heavy gunships, drone carriers, focused laser craft and absorb-and-counter builds. Each pilot has her own starting weapon, passives and trade-offs.

A homecoming story between battles

Collect P to evolve your character's portrait, and share a lively homecoming story with your companions between sorties.

Endless Mode

Clear all ten worlds and the route keeps going. Your level and build carry over into the next round, enemies grow stronger with every loop, and the only question is how far you can go.


  • Roguelike runs with three-choice level-ups
  • Weapon, drone and passive combinations
  • Multi-stage boss armor breaking with clothing damage
  • Ten worlds, ten bosses, plus boss practice
  • Six unlockable pilots and aircraft
  • Endless Mode with ever-stronger loops

Some non-chibi character art features revealing outfits and battle-damaged clothing.

content_details.name: Neon Hustle
content_details.short_description: A first-person management sim set in a living crime-noir town. Recruit workers, pitch clients on the street yourself, manage rising city heat, and keep the operation running before the night forces itself to end. Mature themes, no explicit content.
content_details.about_the_game:
A first-person management sim where you run a street-level operation in a crime-noir border town — recruit, place, price, and protect, from dusk until the day forces itself to end.

You're not clicking through menus from a distance. You're walking the streets yourself — pitching passersby, hauling supplies, flipping motel rooms, and throwing punches when things go wrong. Every system in this game is something you can put your hands on.

Run the operation
Recruit workers, negotiate terms, and station them around town. Set prices, manage a roster with real stats and real limits, and watch your choices show up in the ledger the next morning.

Work the streets yourself
Approach pedestrians directly and pitch them — read the situation, offer a discount, or make your case with confidence. A deal you close yourself always pays better than one that happens without you.

Manage real risk
The city has its own heat — push too hard in one part of town and the consequences follow you there specifically. Robberies, harassment, and undercover cops are all real threats you have to notice and respond to in real time, on foot, before it's too late.

A town that runs without you
Pedestrians go about their own schedules. A courier keeps his own hours. Danger rises and falls with the time of night. You're one operator in a town that keeps moving whether you're watching or not.

Keep the lights on
Wages, rent on your rooms, upkeep, bail — nothing is free, and nothing waits for you to catch up. Every night ends whether you're ready or not, and the next one starts a little riskier than the last.

First-person management sim set in a living, systemic crime-noir town

  • Recruit, negotiate, and manage a roster with real, evolving stats

  • Hands-on street pitching — approach pedestrians and close deals yourself

  • Zone-based City Heat system — risk that responds to where you operate, not just how

  • Real-time threats: robbery, harassment, and undercover police

  • Physical motel management — turn over rooms, restock supplies, clear it for the next session

  • A day/night cycle with a hard nightly cutoff — every night ends, ready or not

  • A courier, pedestrian traffic, and danger levels that all run on their own independent schedules

content_details.name: Strip Club Simulator
content_details.short_description: Buy a run-down club and turn it into the city's hottest gentlemen's club. Check IDs at the door, mix cocktails, hire and train your dancers, open private VIP rooms and host themed nights, and keep the night under control when things get wild.
content_details.about_the_game:
Your club. Your rules. Your night.

Strip Club Simulator puts you in the owner's chair of a small, forgotten club with big potential. Stock the bar, run the door, put your best dancers on stage and turn every night into a success. Reinvest your earnings, earn your reputation one star at a time, and build the most talked-about club in the city.

Run the door

Every guest starts at the door. Check IDs, spot fake ones, keep minors out and decide who gets in. One wrong call can bring the police to your club.

Behind the bar

Order supplies from your wholesaler, stock the fridges and serve your guests before they get impatient. Unlock new recipes and mix cocktails in a few quick steps. Set your own prices, and find the balance between profit and happy guests.

Your dancers, your stars

Hire dancers with their own names, looks and talents. Train their skills, pick their outfits and plan who takes the stage at prime time. Keep an eye on their energy: a tired dancer won't win the crowd. Collect the tips the crowd throws on stage before the shift ends.

Private VIP rooms

High-rolling guests want something more exclusive. Open private rooms, send the right dancer and watch the VIP money roll in. Celebrities and big spenders will only come back if you treat them right.

Build your team

At first you do everything yourself. As your club grows, hire bartenders, bouncers, cleaners and waiters. Every hire has their own speed, focus and reliability, and they get better the longer they work for you. Spend less time mopping floors and more time running your empire.

Every night is different

Drunk fights, guests who cross the line, power cuts, surprise inspections, a celebrity at the door. Every night brings new situations, and every choice you make affects your reputation.

Themed nights and private parties

Throw Neon Nights, Latin Nights, White Parties and exclusive VIP-only events. Prepare the right music, dancers and drinks to hit every goal and turn a good night into a legendary one.

Know your guests

Every guest has a mood. Long waits, empty glasses, dirty floors or bad music will cost you. Your end-of-night report shows exactly what went well, what went wrong and why.

Grow your club

Upgrade with DJ booths, lasers, mirror balls and smoke machines. Place furniture where you want it. Unlock the VIP lounge, a second stage and new areas as your reputation rises from one star to five.

Key features

  • First-person club management: work the door, the bar and the floor yourself
  • ID checks with fake IDs, minors and drunk guests
  • Cocktail recipes, stock management and full control over your prices
  • Hire, train and dress your dancers, and schedule their shifts
  • Private VIP rooms, VIP guests and celebrity visits
  • Staff with skills and levels: bartenders, bouncers, cleaners, waiters
  • Random nightly events that test your judgement
  • Themed nights and exclusive parties
  • Guest satisfaction and a five-star reputation system
  • Club upgrades, light shows, decoration and expansion
